content.title: Did KeyCorp’s Expected C$81 Million Boost Just Shift Bank of Nova Scotia's (TSX:BNS) Investment Narrative?
content.summary: Earlier in January, Scotiabank said it expects its ownership stake in U.S. regional lender KeyCorp to contribute about C$81 million in reported net income, or roughly C$89 million on an adjusted basis, to its fiscal Q1 2026 results to be released on February 24, 2026.
